response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced senior full-stack developer with genuine systems chops (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests/second, Kubernetes deployments, open-source infrastructure), but he falls well short of the role's core requirement of 8 years of C++ experience — his C++ work amounts to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a thesis project. His recent career centers on TypeScript/Node.js product engineering rather than cloud compute platform architecture, and he shows no formal technical-leadership track record mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers, making him a poor match for this C++-heavy platform lead role.
strengths: Real high-scale, low-latency systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby)
Strong software craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, workshops and mentoring through courses and dojos
Long, versatile engineering career spanning backend, infrastructure tooling, embedded, and DevOps setup
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ (roughly under a year of professional C++ work)
No formal technical-lead or people-leadership role managing priorities, deadlines, and cross-team alignment
Recent experience is product-focused full-stack/TypeScript work, not cloud compute platform or distributed-systems architecture
